company.name: SkyLights
company.shortDescription: SkyLights offers a cinematic VR on planes as passenger inflight entertainment.
company.description:
SkyLights offers a cinematic VR on planes as passenger inflight entertainment. It enables passengers to tune out of their environment and escape their flight by enjoying premium cinematic entertainment using VR headsets. 


Skylights integrate content licensing deals, develops software and headsets, and integrates ground operations. All four are sold to airlines as a subscription service. 


The company is incorporated in the US, with headquarters in San Francisco, California.
